text:
Poetry should not be a weapon;
it should be an embrace,
an invention,
a way to show others
what is happening inside them:
that, a discovery,
a breath,
an addition,
a shiver.

Poetry should be
compulsory.

translation.title: Poetry Should Not Be a Weapon...
